The Cursed Prison

Good, you’re all here.
Kasumi, could you give us a sitrep, please?
We’ve been able to confirm a massive energy reading deep below the Mikasa.
However, the energy is unstable and appears to be continuously increasing.
What’s goin’ on here...?
We don’t know...
When <NAME> recovered the jewel, that demon mentioned something...
Something about a “Demon Lord”.

“Demon Lord”...
Then that means...
There really is someone pulling all the strings.
Who could this “Demon Lord” possibly be...?
There is too much we don’t know! So many known unknowns!
If we don’t know, then we have no choice but to investigate.

She’s right.
We’ll be counting on you, .
Easy-peasy
I’ll do my best

Easy-peasy.
We’ve got this in the bag.
Arrogance will only get you killed...
Stay on your toes, <NAME>.
I’ll do my best.
You can’t fight your best if you’re wound up too tight...
You’ve gotta relax, <NAME>.
It’s okay to be a little nervous...
Just do the best you can, <NAME>.
Alright then, <NAME>, please continue your investigation of the Sacred Demon Castle.
There’s only one piece of the Regalia left.
Keep it together.
